pages.description: About Wexley, a bridal salon in Chelsea.
pages.intro: One fitting salon, five houses, and a workroom upstairs.

blocks.heading: Why one room
blocks.body:
We see one bride at a time. The salon is hers for ninety minutes, with the people she brings.

Every gown is fitted upstairs by the same hands that pinned it the first time.

blocks.alt: The fitting salon: painted mouldings, a chandelier and a silk sofa
blocks.caption: The fitting salon, first floor.

vouchers.howToBuy: We reply with a payment link. The voucher comes as a card in the post or a picture on WhatsApp.
vouchers.terms: Use it towards a gown, a veil or alterations. Not exchangeable for cash.

visitInfo.title: Finding *the mews.*
visitInfo.intro: Off Sloane Avenue, eight minutes' walk from South Kensington.

steps: Leave by the Pelham Street exit
Walk along Pelham Street to Sloane Avenue
Turn left; Vane Mews is the second opening on the right
Get off at the Sloane Avenue stop
Walk back thirty metres to the mews
Ask for Vane Mews, off Sloane Avenue, SW3
The mews is cobbled; the door is the grey one with the brass plate

parking.name: Pay-by-phone bays nearby
parking.price: check the signs on the street
parking.note: Residents' bays are marked; avoid those.

access.label: Fitting room on the ground floor

visitInfo.accessNote: The salon and fitting room are on the ground floor; the workroom is upstairs and fittings can be held downstairs.

questions.a: Yes. The salon is yours for the ninety minutes, so we see one bride at a time.

questions.q: How many people can I bring?
questions.a: Up to three. For more, tell us when you ask and we'll find a longer slot.
Of the gown you choose, yes. We ask you not to photograph the rest of the rail.
Mostly 8 to 16. Every gown is ordered in your size, so a sample that doesn't close still tells you a lot.

questions.q: How far ahead should I order?
questions.a: About nine months before the wedding. Sooner is possible for some gowns; ask us.
Half the gown's price when you order, the rest at your first fitting.
Taking in, hemming and a bustle are. Design changes we price before we start.
